description: This file defines a REST controller named HealthController that provides a health check endpoint (/health). It uses Spring Boot annotations for REST mapping and Swagger annotations for API documentation. The controller exposes a simple status response indicating that the service is healthy.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: REST controller exposing a health check endpoint, used for indicating service health status.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /health, returning a JSON payload with status 'ok' indicating service health.
